author: rhaarhoff
body:
## Why

`quorum-audit` verifies the right PR head SHA on `issue_comment` runs, but GitHub attaches the implicit workflow check to the default-branch SHA for those events. That leaves the PR surface showing a cosmetic red/missing signal even when the ceremony was correctly verified.

This PR publishes an explicit `quorum-audit` check-run against the computed PR head SHA so comment-triggered verification is visible where reviewers actually look.

Tracks #22.

## What Changed

- add `checks: write` to `quorum-audit.yml`
- export the verified PR head SHA and role flags from the verification step
- publish an explicit completed `quorum-audit` check-run against the PR head SHA on both pass and fail paths
- keep the workflow report-only with `continue-on-error: true`
- update ADR-0008 rollout text to note that comment-triggered verification is surfaced on the PR head SHA

## Out of Scope

- promoting `quorum-audit` to required
- changing the quorum verification regexes or trigger set
- changing branch protection or any application/runtime code

## Bootstrap Gap

This PR's own `issue_comment`-driven runs will still use the pre-fix workflow from `main`, so this branch cannot self-prove the new publisher behavior before merge. The fix takes effect for the next PR after this lands, the same bootstrap pattern we documented when `issue_comment` support first shipped.

## Edge Cases

On this PR's `pull_request` run, GitHub surfaced the explicit published `quorum-audit` as a separate rollup entry rather than collapsing it into the workflow's implicit check. That is cosmetic, not functional: the explicit published check-run is still what will make `issue_comment` verification visible on the PR head SHA once this workflow is on `main`.

## Local Validation

- `actionlint -color .github/workflows/quorum-audit.yml`
- `pnpm exec nx sync:check`
- `pnpm exec nx run-many -t lint -- --max-warnings=0`
- `git diff --check`

## Summary

Unblocks Solana versioned (v0) transaction signing — the flow that powers OpenSea NFT purchases, Jupiter swaps, and most modern Solana dApps. Previously the REST + RPC handlers rejected v0 with `501 Versioned transactions not yet supported` because KeepKey firmware's `SolanaSignTx` (type 752) parses legacy messages only.

> Stacked on #125 — merge that first. Retarget to `develop` once #125 lands, or GitHub will auto-update the base.

## Approach

Route v0 transactions through `SolanaSignMessage` (firmware type 754) instead of `SolanaSignTx` (type 752). `SolanaSignMessage` performs raw Ed25519 signing over whatever bytes you give it — no parsing. Feed it the exact message slice (`[0x80 prefix][MessageV0 body]`) that a v0 signature must cover.

Solana signs message payloads (not tx wrappers). The wire format for *both* legacy and v0 transactions is `[sigCount][sigs][message]`, so the same sig slot and same assembly work for both — we just switch which firmware call produces the sig.

## What this does not do

- **Does not resolve ALTs on-device.** The KeepKey shows a generic \"sign message\" prompt for v0, not a parsed-tx summary with amounts and destinations. Users must review the decoded v0 in Vault's approval dialog.
- **Does not change firmware.** Full on-device v0 parsing + ALT display is a larger firmware-side project. This PR unlocks the flows today using an existing firmware primitive.
- **Does not add ALT-resolution UI preview.** The v0 tx signs correctly regardless; adding a richer preview in Vault's approval dialog is a UI follow-up and can ship independently.

## Changes

- `src/bun/solana-tx.ts`: adds `solanaMessageSlice()` — returns the exact bytes a signer must sign. Legacy returns the message payload; v0 preserves the `0x80` prefix.
- `src/bun/rest-api.ts` (`POST /solana/sign-transaction`): replaces the 501 with a legacy/v0 split. Legacy → `wallet.solanaSignTx`; v0 → `wallet.solanaSignMessage`. Reassembly uses `parsed.sigStart`.
- `src/bun/index.ts` (`solanaSignTx` RPC): mirrors the REST split; cleans up the reassembly contract (raw tx is now always base64'd back from the parsed buffer, not re-decoded).
- `__tests__/solana-tx.test.ts`: +5 tests pinning the `solanaMessageSlice()` and reassembly-offset contracts across legacy and v0.

## Test plan

- [x] `bun test __tests__/solana-tx.test.ts` — 14/14 pass
- [x] Full unit suite — 93/93 pass
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` — clean (pre-existing unrelated `minimatch` warning filtered)
- [ ] Manual: legacy single-sig tx still signs and reassembles as before
- [ ] Manual: v0 tx from OpenSea or constructed fixture → device shows \"sign message\" prompt → returns valid signed v0 bytes → Solana RPC `simulateTransaction` accepts the signed tx
- [ ] Manual: malformed prefix-first layout still rejects at 400 (from #125)

## Security trade-off

This is \"vault-displayed, device-blind\" signing: the user's review happens in Vault's UI, not on the hardware screen. Industry-standard interim approach (Ledger and Trezor did the same for years before adding native v0 parsers). A future firmware PR should add on-device v0 + ALT display.

body:
…sticas atômicas (E3.3 + E3.4)

-------------

## Descrição
Esta PR implementa o escopo combinado das entregas **E3.3 (Partidas e Scorebook)** e **E3.4 (Stats, Standing, MVP)**. 

A decisão principal de arquitetura aqui foi acoplar os cálculos da E3.4 diretamente na finalização da partida (E3.3). O endpoint `finishMatch` agora executa 10 passos atômicos em uma única `$transaction` do Prisma, garantindo que nenhuma partida seja finalizada sem atualizar a tabela de classificação e computar o MVP.

## Principais Alterações
* **Schema:** Adicionados `startedAt` e `finishedAt` no model `Match`.
* **Score Calculator:** Lógica de placar extraída para funções puras e testáveis, derivando pontos sempre de `MatchEvent`. Nenhum endpoint aceita placar no body (Regra C5).
* **Guards & Segurança:** Implementado `requirePlayerInRoster` e `requireMatchOfficial` (C4 - ABAC) para garantir que apenas mesários designados insiram eventos de jogadores confirmados no elenco.
* **State Machine:** Transições validadas (ex: SCHEDULED -> LIVE -> FINISHED).
* **Auditoria:** Eventos atômicos gerados no AuditLog para transições de status da partida e anulações (`voidEvent`), não poluindo o log com cada lance individual.

## Checklist Interno
- [x] Migrations geradas e testadas.
- [x] Validações Zod cobrindo inputs e proibindo injeção de valores calculados no server-side.
- [x] Teste de recálculo de placar ao dar "void" em um evento anterior.
- [x] Cálculo do P-VAL testado contra divisões por zero (FGA = 0).

## Como Testar
1. Crie uma partida oficial e atribua um usuário como `SCOREKEEPER`.
2. Inicie a partida e registre eventos variados usando o usuário do mesário.
3. Finalize a partida via painel admin e verifique se as tabelas de `MatchStat`, `Standing` e `MatchMvp` foram atualizadas em cascata.

## Summary

Adds sklearn-compatible `Pipeline`, `FeatureUnion`, `ColumnTransformer` plus a process-global `register_estimator()` registry so downstream consumers can compose domain-specific heads (BOCPD, HRP, regime classifiers) with framework primitives like `StandardScaler`. Cross-SDK alignment with [kailash-rs#402](https://github.com/esperie-enterprise/kailash-rs/issues/402) commit `5429928c`.

## API

```python
import kailash_ml as kml

@kml.register_estimator
class BocpdHead:
    def fit(self, X, y=None): return self
    def predict(self, X): return ...

pipe = kml.Pipeline([
    ("scaler", kml.StandardScaler()),
    ("bocpd", BocpdHead()),
])
```

## Design

- **Explicit registration, not duck-type allowlist opening** per `rules/agent-reasoning.md`.
- Registry keyed by (module, qualname) so re-imports collapse on one slot.
- Thread-safe (threading.Lock around mutations).
- Idempotent double-registration.
- Shared `_protocol.py` validator module — identical semantics across the three composites, one enforcement site.
- `ColumnTransformer` honors the sklearn sentinels `"passthrough"` and `"drop"` without requiring registration.

## Tests

14/14 passing Tier 1 unit tests at `packages/kailash-ml/tests/unit/test_register_estimator.py`. Covers:
- decorator + function registration forms
- unregister round-trip
- idempotent double-register
- rejects instances vs classes
- Pipeline / FeatureUnion / ColumnTransformer end-to-end with custom + sklearn mixed
- passthrough/drop sentinels bypass registration
- missing protocol still rejected after registration

## Test plan

- [x] Composites work end-to-end with real `fit()` and `predict()` / `transform()`

author: ikuwow
body:
# Add weekly dotfiles improvement routine

## Purpose

Add `claude/routines/weekly-improvement.md` — an instruction file for a Claude Code
Routine that runs every Saturday at 03:00 JST and creates improvement PRs for this
dotfiles repository.

Inspired by: https://zenn.dev/genda_jp/articles/f425cc7354f608

## Design

The routine instruction file lives in the repository so that:
- The instructions are version-controlled and reviewable
- `/schedule` only needs a one-line prompt referencing this file
- The instructions themselves can be improved via future PRs

The routine is not configured here — the user will run `/schedule` manually after
merging, pointing to this file.

## Scope

The routine covers the entire dotfiles repository:
- Shell scripts (shellcheck compliance, readability, error handling)
- Configuration files (consistency, organization)
- Claude Code config under `claude/` (rules, skills, hooks, settings)
- Dead code and unused configurations
- Security issues

## Feedback loop

The routine is instructed to check past PRs (merged vs. closed-without-merge) and
read rejection comments before proposing changes, avoiding repeated mistakes.

## How to set up the Routine after merging

Run `/schedule` in a Claude Code session with these settings:

- Cron: `0 18 * * 5` (UTC Friday 18:00 = JST Saturday 03:00)
- Repository: ikuwow/dotfiles
- Prompt: `Read and follow the instructions in claude/routines/weekly-improvement.md`

## Verification

- [x] `claude/routines/weekly-improvement.md` is readable and complete
- [ ] After merging: run `/schedule` to create the Routine with the settings above
- [ ] After creating the Routine: run `/schedule run` to verify it executes and produces a draft PR

Two users viewing the same task now see each other's comments without a manual reload.

## What shipped

**Hook** — [src/features/tasks/hooks/useTaskCommentsRealtime.ts](src/features/tasks/hooks/useTaskCommentsRealtime.ts)
- Subscribes to `supabase.channel("task_comments:task=:id")` scoped per-task.
- Listens for any `postgres_changes` on `public.task_comments` filtered by `task_id=eq.:id`.
- Invalidates `['taskComments', taskId]` on every payload.
- `removeChannel` in the cleanup. No-ops when `taskId === null`.
- Deliberately coarse: the realtime payload lacks the `author` join, so a full refetch is correct.

**Wiring** — [TaskComments.tsx](src/features/tasks/components/TaskComments/TaskComments.tsx)
- Calls `useTaskCommentsRealtime(taskId)` at the top of the component, sibling of `useTaskComments`.

**Channel-split note** — [Project.tsx](src/pages/Project.tsx)
- One-line comment above the project-scoped `project-tasks:${projectId}` channel noting that comments are split into their own per-task channel (`useTaskCommentsRealtime`) and must not be merged here. Prevents noisy task-channel traffic when the detail pane is closed.

**Docs** — [AGENT_CONTEXT.md](docs/AGENT_CONTEXT.md)
- New "Comments (Wave 26)" golden-path bullet covering the data flow end-to-end.

| Kind | File | Count |

Este PR introduce los elementos para la ejecucion asincrona (en segundo plano) de algoritmos de mineria de datos con preservacion de privacidad proporcionados por la plataforma Rory. Se implementó un sistema de colas FIFO manejado por eventos (TaskCreatedEvent) y un sistema de balanceo de carga para distribuir el procesamiento eficientemente a través de un pool de múltiples instancias de Rory.


- **Background worker & consumer**: Se agregó el módulo `calpulli.core.worker` para escuchar e interceptar los TaskCreatedEvent, gestionando la ejecución en segundo plano mediante una cola estricta FIFO.
- **Balanceo de carga**: Se creó el módulo `calpulli.core.load_balancing` (factory y strategies) para gestionar pools de plataformas Rory. Actualmente soporta las estrategias de balanceo Round Robin y Pseudorandom.
- **Infraestructura como Código (IaC)**: Se incluyeron artefactos de despliegue para MictlanX y Rory, así como la configuración de variables de entorno por defecto

Ademas se agregaron instrucciones básicas de instalación para mictlanx y rory. 

Este PR servir como base para los issues #41 #42 #44 #45 #46 #47 
### ⚠️ Notas importantes y próximos pasos
Para dar continuidad a este PR y completar el flujo, es necesario resolver los siguientes issues asociados:

* **Gestión de estados de tareas (#44):** Hace falta agregar el campo `status` a la entidad `Task` e implementar los métodos asociados para la actualización y transición de estados del ciclo de vida de la tarea.
* **Valores de parámetros (#41):** Es fundamental crear e integrar los modelos `NumericParameterValue` y `StringParameterValue`. Actualmente se ha omitido la extracción dinámica de estos valores y el sistema opera temporalmente con parámetros por defecto.
* **Revisión de inyección de dependencias:** Hay que estudiar detalladamente el funcionamiento de la inyección `task_consumer: TaskConsumer = Depends(MX.get_task_consumer)` ubicada en el controlador `POST /tasks/run`, para realizar los ajustes necesarios y garantizar su correcta integración con los modelos de valores para los parametros.

## Summary

Fixes #40.

When smart climate is in AUTO mode with a preset, `_async_sync_real_climate` correctly turns the real device OFF once the room reaches the comfort band. The resulting state-change event caused `_on_real_climate_update` to treat the OFF transition as an external setpoint change (because `_updating_from_control` was False on the sensor-triggered path and `_last_real_mode` was not updated on OFF), clearing the preset to `none`.

- Skip external-change detection in `_on_real_climate_update` when the real device reports `state == HVACMode.OFF`. An OFF state carries no meaningful setpoint to compare against.
- Added `test_real_device_off_does_not_exit_preset` regression test that forces a stale expected target well beyond the 0.5C threshold and verifies the preset is preserved.

author: sirkirby
body:
## Summary

- Renames default intelligence task `full-intelligence` → `vault-evolve` and adds migration v6 that moves user overrides.
- Adds new manual-only `vault-seed` task for brownfield codebases — explores the repo via `fs_read`/`fs_list`/`fs_tree`/`code_grep` (thin wrapper around `@vscode/ripgrep`) and produces an initial spore set + digest.
- Hardens Claude SDK runtime: `RuntimeExecutionError` preserves tokens/turns/cost on errors like max-turns instead of reporting zero.
- Phase prompts now support `{{max_turns}}` / `{{phase_name}}` / `{{phase_tools}}` template variables resolved against the effective phase config (post myco.yaml override).
- Internal refactors: shared `interpolate` helper, params-object signatures for `composeTaskPrompt` / `composePhasePrompt` / `executePhase`, and a `buildPhaseResult` factory that unifies success + failure + checkpoint-replay call sites.

## Why

Myco's existing tasks only operate on captured session transcripts, which is useless on a freshly-adopted repo. Vault-seed fills that gap: on a cold vault it infers knowledge directly from source via filesystem and grep tools, producing a meaningful spore set and digest on first run. The `full-intelligence` → `vault-evolve` rename pairs naturally with the new `vault-seed` verb — seed the vault, evolve the vault.

The claude-sdk telemetry gap became visible while debugging max-turn failures on vault-seed: runs that really spent tokens were showing as `tokens_used = 0`, which made tuning impossible.

## Design notes

**Runtime portability.** Exploration tools live in-process behind the same MCP plumbing as vault tools (works on both claude-sdk and openai-agents runtimes, no subprocess MCP servers). Tool schemas use plain `.optional()` / `.string()` / `.number()` and avoid `.default()`, `.min()`, `.max()`, `.int()`, `.positive()` — those Zod refinements emit JSON-schema keywords (`default`, `minimum`, `exclusiveMinimum`, etc.) that OpenAI's strict function-calling rejects, which otherwise silently breaks tool registration on that runtime.

**No model pinning.** Vault-seed uses reasoning levels, not explicit model names, so it tracks the user's provider config uniformly across runtimes.

**Template variables.** Turn budgets and tool lists are configurable per phase in myco.yaml. Hard-coding them in prompts drifts from reality when users override — template vars resolve against the effective phase config at dispatch time.

## Verification

- [x] `tsc --noEmit` clean
- [x] `npx vitest run` — 2986 / 2989 passing (3 pre-existing skips)
- [x] `make build` — green end-to-end
- [x] Standalone verification script covered: template substitution for all 7 vault-seed phases, `buildPhaseResult` in all three call shapes, migration v6 edge cases, OpenAI strict-mode schema compatibility of the 4 exploration tools
- [x] Live dry-run on Claude SDK: vault-seed completed end-to-end on this repo — 23 spores (13 decisions / 6 gotchas / 4 architecture, importance 6-9), 3 digest tiers written, ~\$2.40 for a full brownfield seed

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify on a cold vault (no existing spores): vault-seed creates the initial set cleanly, re-seed check returns empty, no `vault_resolve_spore` calls
- [ ] Verify on a warm vault: re-running vault-seed triggers the "vault already populated" short-circuit via the Step 1 re-seed check

## Summary
- Wires the Open-Meteo weather factor (session 20 groundwork) into the projection model as a per-start multiplier alongside wOBA and park
- Persists weather in v2 locked projection breakdowns so accuracy tracking can later isolate weather's contribution
- Surfaces temp + factor in ProjectionTooltip for outdoor parks

## Changes
- **api/projection.py**: `get_weather_factor(park, date)` applied in live projection loop and lock path; new `weather` block in v2 breakdown JSON
- **components/ProjectionTooltip.tsx**: `StartDetail` interface extended; weather row in single-start mode; weather chip in total mode summary

## Safety
- All failure paths in `get_weather_factor` return `factor=1.0` (dome override, unknown park, network failure, cache miss) — math is always safe
- 3hr Redis cache prevents Open-Meteo rate pressure
- ±5% hard cap on the multiplier prevents extreme weather from breaking the model
- Dome parks (TB, TOR, HOU, MIA, SEA, TEX, ARI, MIL) return neutral; UI hides weather row to reduce noise

## Test plan
- [ ] Refresh a period containing an outdoor park (e.g. BOS, COL, CHC) → tooltip shows Weather row with temp
- [ ] Refresh a period containing a dome park (e.g. TB, TOR) → no Weather row appears
- [ ] Diagnostic endpoint `/api/weather?park=BOS&date=2026-04-18` still returns expected shape
- [ ] Check Vercel logs for `[weather.py]` cache hits on subsequent refreshes within 3hrs

author: sameexpert
body:
This consists of 2 modifications:

### Foot: 

https://github.com/nwg-piotr/nwg-shell/blob/997b0dfc3cbc2694bddd05b9c0ab61b3ff7e77a1/nwg_shell/skel/config/foot/foot.ini#L67
```diff
--- a/nwg_shell/skel/config/foot/foot.ini
+++ b/nwg_shell/skel/config/foot/foot.ini
@@ -64,7 +64,7 @@ gamma-correct-blending=no
# hide-when-typing=no
# alternate-scroll-mode=yes

-[colors]
+[colors-dark]
alpha=0.9
# foreground=dcdccc
# background=111111
```
Ths prevents this warning:
```console
deprecated: foot: [colors]: use [colors-dark] instead
```

### Sway:

https://github.com/nwg-piotr/nwg-shell/blob/997b0dfc3cbc2694bddd05b9c0ab61b3ff7e77a1/nwg_shell/skel/config/sway/config#L96-L98
```diff
--- a/nwg_shell/skel/config/sway/config
+++ b/nwg_shell/skel/config/sway/config
@@ -94,8 +94,8 @@ bindsym XF86AudioRaiseVolume exec pactl set-sink-volume 0 +2%
bindsym XF86AudioLowerVolume exec pactl set-sink-volume 0 -2%

# backlight
-bindsym XF86MonBrightnessUp exec light -A 5
-bindsym XF86MonBrightnessDown exec light -U 5
+bindsym XF86MonBrightnessUp exec brightnessctl s +5%
+bindsym XF86MonBrightnessDown exec brightnessctl s 5%-

# Reload the configuration file
bindsym $Mod+Shift+c reload
```
`light` seems to be a dead project, or at least I am not able to visit its repository or homepage:
- https://haikarainen.github.io/light/
- https://github.com/haikarainen/light

So I am suggesting here to make `brightnessctl` the default (which `nwg-panel` works with effortlessly).
